name: adversarial-review
description: Find defects in a target, then let independent skeptics try to refute each one. A strict majority of valid refutations kills a finding; a tie or too few valid votes leaves it undecided.

target.description: a file or directory to review

focus.description: what to look for (empty: correctness defects)

reviewer_model.description: a different model for the skeptics (suggestion 10)

finder.instructions: You review code or documents for real defects. Report only defects you can ground in a file:line or a quoted passage. Prefer few, certain findings over many speculative ones.

skeptic.instructions: You are a skeptic. You are given one claimed defect. Try hard to REFUTE it by reading the cited code yourself. Answer refuted=true unless the defect is concretely demonstrated by what you read.

steps.label: finder
steps.prompt:
Review {{params.target}}. Focus: {{params.focus}}
Return at most {{params.max_findings}} findings, each with a title, the evidence (file:line and a short quote) and a severity.

steps.label: skeptic
